en.p: The position $x(t)$ at time $t$ of a point P moving on a number line is, for two constants $a$, $b$,
When the velocity $v(t)$ of point P at time $t$ satisfies $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{1}|v(t)|\,dt=2$, which of the statements in <Statements> are correct? [4 points]

box: b. There exists $t_1$ in the open interval $(0,\,1)$ with $|x(t_1)|>1$.
c. If $|x(t)|<1$ for every $t$ with $0\le t\le 1$, then there exists $t_2$ in the open interval $(0,\,1)$ with $x(t_2)=0$.
